newsitem.title: USA: Starwood agrees to buy hotels for $470 mln.
newsitem.headline: Starwood agrees to buy hotels for $470 mln.

text.p: Starwood Lodging Trust and Starwood Lodging Corp said Friday they a agreed to acquire 15 hotels from Flatley Co/Tara Hotels for $470 million.
The 15 hotels are located in the northeastern U.S., with a large concentration of the properties in suburban Boston.
Eight of the properties are flagged Sheratons; one is a Hilton and six are independently flagged under the Tara name. The trust said the deal is scheduled to close in early to mid-September.
Starwood said the hotels should produce revenues after cosmetic renovations. It plans to begin most of the renovations during the winter in 1998, and is targeting a completion date of spring 1999.
